title: Story premise ENT090: The Sequel Before Scene One
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: Episode twelve is ready. Episode one is a rectangle. Takeaway/theme: A complete small story can support what comes next.
description: A storyteller wants to launch a ten-part saga, but every unfinished first scene splits into more sequel posters. They fold the posters into a small screening room, finish a self-contained first scene, and let the single audience member choose whether another poster comes down from storage.
